generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per the attached Tender Document.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Desilting of water tank at Melmundoli Kere, Mavinakodlu RF

itemList.description: Engaging labours for cleaning tank area by cutting & removing unwanted bushes, debries and tree branches fallen in tank.

De-silting of Feeder channel/canal in dry condition by excavating the deposited bed material and deposing off the same by stacking/formation of embankment or as directed including cost of all machinery, labour and all neccessary work as directed and complete as per sepecification.

Excavation and removal of silt and silt mixed with sand from canal bed by manual means including disposing off the same in spoil bank or on the canal embankment in layers as directed with all other ancillary operations complete.
